titleEn: Commercial Renovation Cost Burnaby 2026: Real Tenant Improvement Prices From $45 to $280 Per Sq Ft
titleZh: 本拿比商業裝修費用2026：真實商舖裝修造價每尺$45至$280
contentEn:
Commercial renovation costs in Burnaby in 2026 range from $45 per square foot for a basic landlord-improved unit to $280 per square foot for a full high-end tenant fit-out. Office tenant improvements, retail store refreshes, and warehouse modifications each fall at different points on that spectrum. Reno Stars has completed commercial projects across Metrotown, Brentwood, and Burnaby's Light Industrial zones — here are the real numbers.

2026 Commercial Renovation Cost Breakdown — Burnaby

Project TypeCost Per Sq FtTypical Scope
Basic landlord TI (paint, flooring, trade fixtures)$45 – $90/sq ftNew paint, LED lighting, flooring replacement, minor partitions
Standard office fit-out$90 – $175/sq ftPartition walls, HVAC adjustments, upgraded electrical, ceilings, millwork
Full high-end commercial build-out$175 – $280/sq ftCustom millwork, premium finishes, complex mechanical, feature walls

Real Burnaby Commercial Projects by Reno Stars

Reno Stars completed a retail renovation for a Metrotown toy store covering 2,200 sq ft at a cost of $175,000 — approximately $80 per square foot — delivering new display fixtures, flooring, and an updated storefront within an 8-week timeline. The project required coordination with Strata and Metrotown shopping centre management.

View the Metrotown toy store renovation project →

For a warehouse-to-office conversion in Burnaby's commercial industrial zone, Reno Stars delivered a 1,800 sq ft office tenant improvement project at $165,000, or approximately $92 per square foot. Work included demising walls, new washrooms, kitchenette, and mechanical upgrades to meet current building codes.

View the Burnaby warehouse office TI project →

What Drives Commercial Renovation Cost in Burnaby

Building permit requirements. Burnaby's Building Permit requirement for commercial tenant improvements depends on scope. Projects involving structural changes, fire-rated assemblies, HVAC modifications, or changes of use require a full building permit. Basic cosmetic work under $50,000 may qualify for a quick permit exemption. Reno Stars handles the permit application process as part of the project scope.

Location premium. Metrotown and Brentwood commercial units carry higher rental rates and correspondingly higher construction costs due to strict Strata and commercial property management requirements. Hasting Street and East Burnaby corridors offer more affordable options for light industrial and storage conversions.

Use classification. Assembly, care, and high-hazard occupancies (A2, B, F) require sprinkler and fire separation upgrades that can add $8–$15 per square foot to the base cost.

Burnaby Commercial Renovation Timeline

  • Basic TI: 4 – 8 weeks (permit may be exemption-only)
  • Standard office fit-out: 8 – 14 weeks (building permit required)
  • Full high-end build-out: 14 – 24 weeks (building permit + potential structural)

Reno Stars manages the full project lifecycle: initial scoping, cost consultation, permit application, contractor coordination, and final inspection handover. For commercial tenants in Burnaby — whether you are opening in Metrotown Mall, Brentwood Town Centre, or a standalone industrial unit — the starting point is a site assessment and a detailed cost proposal.

Burnaby Business District Coverage

Reno Stars serves commercial clients across all major Burnaby business districts: Metrotown, Brentwood, Edmonds, Hastings Street, North Road, and the Sperling / Duthie industrial areas. Service area projects include office tenant improvements, retail store fit-outs, warehouse modifications, and food service facility upgrades.

How much does a commercial tenant improvement cost in Burnaby?

Burnaby commercial tenant improvements range from $45/sq ft for basic cosmetic work to $280/sq ft for premium full-fit-outs. A standard office TI in Burnaby typically costs $90–$175/sq ft in 2026.

Does Burnaby require a building permit for commercial renovation?

Burnaby requires a building permit for most commercial tenant improvements involving structural changes, fire-rated assemblies, HVAC work, or changes of occupancy classification. Basic cosmetic work under $50,000 may qualify for exemption. Reno Stars reviews your scope and handles permit applications.

How long does a commercial renovation take in Burnaby?

A standard office tenant improvement in Burnaby takes 8–14 weeks from permit approval to handover. High-end or complex commercial fit-outs can take 14–24 weeks. Basic TI work may complete in 4–8 weeks if no permit is required.

What is included in a standard commercial renovation?

A standard commercial renovation in Burnaby typically includes: partition walls, upgraded electrical and lighting, HVAC adjustments, suspended ceilings, flooring, paint, millwork, and code-compliant washroom upgrades. Scope varies by project and building type.

Can Reno Stars handle Strata-approved commercial work in Burnaby?

Yes. Reno Stars has experience coordinating commercial tenant improvements with Burnaby Strata councils and commercial property management companies, including Metrotown and Brentwood-area buildings.

Planning a commercial tenant improvement in Burnaby? Contact Reno Stars for a cost proposal and site assessment.

工程類型每尺造價常見範圍

本拿比商業裝修費用決定因素

建築許可證要求。本拿比商業裝修是否需要建築許可證取決於工程範圍。涉及結構改造、消防分級組裝、空調改裝或用途變更的項目需要完整建築許可證。造價低於$50,000的簡單工程可能豁免許可證。聚星裝修代辦許可證申請流程。

區位差異。Metrotown及Brentwood商業單位的租金較高，相應的施工成本亦偏高，且受嚴格的立案法團及商業物管規定約束。Hasting Street及東本拿比走廊的輕工業及儲存改建則更具性價比。

用途分類。A2、B、F類用途（Assembly、Care、High-Hazard）需升級消防灑水及防火分隔，每尺造價額外增加$8–$15。

本拿比商業裝修工期

  • 基本商戶裝修：4至8週（可能豁免許可證）
  • 標準寫字樓裝修：8至14週（需要建築許可證）
  • 高端商業全屋裝修：14至24週（建築許可證+潛在結構工程）

聚星裝修提供商業裝修全流程服務：初步評估、造價諮詢、許可證申請、承包商協調及最終驗收移交。不論您是在Metrotown商場、Brentwood商場還是獨立工業單位，項目的起點都是現場評估及詳細造價提案。

本拿比商業裝修每尺多少錢？

本拿比商業裝修費用2026年介乎每平方尺$45（基本商戶裝修）至每平方尺$280（高端全屋裝修）。標準寫字樓裝修通常為每尺$90至$175。

本拿比商業裝修需要許可證嗎？

本拿比大多數商業裝修工程涉及結構改造、消防組裝、空調改裝或用途變更時需要建築許可證。造價低於$50,000的簡單工程可能豁免。聚星裝修在評估項目範圍後代辦許可證申請。

本拿比商業裝修需要多長時間？

本拿比標準寫字樓裝修從許可證獲批到移交通常需要8至14週。高端或複雜商業裝修可能需要14至24週。如無需許可證，基本商戶裝修可在4至8週內完工。

聚星裝修可以承接本拿比立案法團旗下的商業工程嗎？

可以。聚星裝修有協調本拿比商業裝修與立案法團及商業物業管理公司的經驗，包括Metrotown及Brentwood地區的樓宇。
